infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FairFares uses your location to set ride pickup, find nearby drivers, and estimate distance.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow FairFares to take a photo that you choose to send in FChat.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow FairFares to select photos and videos that you choose to send in FChat.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow FairFares to share your live location only when you explicitly start location sharing in FChat.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow FairFares to select photos and videos that you choose to send in FChat.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow FairFares to take a photo that you choose to send in FChat.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow FairFares to privately find contacts who chose to be discoverable and let you select a contact to share in FChat. Your address book is not uploaded.
